resolution_summary: Plan ARIA-V3 Phase B1 (commit cf30da50) promoted the spike doc to proven-contract status. The kernel-side argv shape is locked by invariant I-V3-21. The four verified_* placeholder fields in ci_executor_contract_proven.md await one operator-supervised live invocation (out-of-band) but the architectural kernel work is complete: workflow installs pinned @anthropic-ai/claude-code, OAuth preflight refuses on missing secret, vars.ARIA_MOCK_KILL_SWITCH reads ahead of the flipped 'false' default, mock_mode_default_flipped audit event emitted per invocation, aria-agent-executor.yml added to V2 I-25 governed-workflow allowlist. Plan ARIA-V3.1 §2b updated this debt file to reflect the on-disk resolved state so the daily-report aggregator (now filesystem-scan SSoT) renders the correct status.
permanent_fix_required: Operator provisions CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN repo secret, dispatches aria-agent-executor.yml workflow with mock=false against a synthetic or operator-validated pending request, captures the response envelope artefact, and validates the four hard criteria. Update tools/aria-poc/ci_executor_contract_spike.md What is verified section with the real-run evidence (ACCEPTED or kernel-level REJECTED claim outcome plus zero-hit lease-token audit). Switch aria-agent-executor.yml inputs.mock.default to false (or set repo variable ARIA_AGENT_EXECUTOR_MOCK_DEFAULT=false). Phase 6 agent-eval CI workflow then promotes real-mode runs as the primary path; aria_agent_eval_mock_only_total stays as the fallback metric.
root_cause_summary: Plan 020 Phase 5 — CI Real OAuth Smoke contract closure requires operator-supervised provision of CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN repo secret plus manual gh workflow run aria-agent-executor.yml -f mock=false invocation. Without the supervised end-to-end run, four hard acceptance criteria from Plan v3.3 Phase 5 cannot be validated: (1) response envelope schema validity against agent_contract .validate_response, (2) submit-result claim outcome producing real ACCEPTED or kernel-level REJECTED state transition, (3) metric segregation under live counter increments, (4) lease-token leak audit returning zero hits in workflow logs and uploaded artefacts. Until those four criteria are satisfied, Phase 6 Agent Eval Harness operates in mock mode only and the response envelope contract surface remains unverified against a real Claude Code OAuth invocation.

short_term_action_taken.rationale: aria-agent-executor.yml workflow_dispatch input mock default remains true; ci_executor mock-mode path produces a deterministic envelope shape so the kernel pipeline (claim, submit-result, governance event emission) gets full coverage. The forthcoming aria_agent_eval_mock_only_total counter introduced in Phase 6 keeps mock-mode evaluations segregated from real-mode evaluations so a future contract closure does not pollute historical eval data.
